Question ID: SPEECH_U04_L05_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.LST.01

Source description for item 1: A source uses headings, lists, or examples to organize information for readers. Which choice best shows source structure and purpose skill?

answer.text: A. Choose a source because it has a title

feedback.text: This choice is too weak because it does not connect source structure, evidence, or central idea to the speech task.

answer.text: B. Identify how the feature organizes the information for a speech audience

feedback.text: Correct. This choice uses the source accurately and connects the source information to research-supported speech communication.

answer.text: C. Use a feature without explaining its purpose

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception. Check the source purpose, central idea, and support before choosing evidence.

answer.text: D. Pick details that do not fit the speech purpose

feedback.text: This choice does not give the speaker a reliable way to use source information in a speech.
